notes: Unreal Engine 4 title using DirectX 11, which is the best-supported path on Apple Silicon.
No kernel-level anti-cheat, so nothing blocks it from running under Wine.
Rating is inherited from CrossOver's published database and has not yet been re-verified by EasyPlay on this machine.

hints: RIDE 4 is sold through Steam, so EasyPlay installs the Steam client into this game's bottle first.
Sign in to Steam when it appears, then start the RIDE 4 download. EasyPlay takes over again once it finishes.
The download is roughly 50 GB. Keep the Mac awake and plugged in.

knownIssues.title: Missing Visual C++ runtime
knownIssues.fix: The game needs Microsoft's C++ runtime, which isn't in this bottle yet. EasyPlay can install it for you.

knownIssues.title: Graphics translation didn't start
knownIssues.fix: The DirectX-to-Metal layer failed to load. Switching this game to the built-in translator usually fixes it, at a cost in frame rate.

knownIssues.title: Vulkan unavailable
knownIssues.fix: DXVK needs Vulkan, which isn't working here. Switch this game to D3DMetal, which talks to Metal directly and doesn't need Vulkan.

knownIssues.title: Steam isn't running
knownIssues.fix: RIDE 4 checks for Steam at launch. EasyPlay will start Steam in this bottle first and then retry.
